# Copilot Instructions

This repository contains an autoscript to help Spider-Man buy new web cartridges.

## Project Overview

A lightweight automation script for managing web cartridge purchases.

## Guidelines

- Keep scripts simple and focused on their single responsibility
- Add comments to explain non-obvious logic
- Validate inputs before processing them

## Development

- No build step required; scripts run directly
- Test changes manually by running the script and verifying expected output
